sentence: Clean up the backyard and trim the hedges.

observation.model_notes: All 3 supplied photos are interior shots of the same home (a living room with a brick accent wall and fireplace, an adjoining dining area, and what appears to be a second living space with an AC unit and desk) — none show a yard, backyard, side yard, hedges, or any outdoor area. The customer asked to clean up the backyard and trim hedges, but no yard is visible in any photo, so no service lines, sections, or hazards can be scoped from this photo set. Photo-2 does show a glimpse of an exterior fenced area and street through an open door/window, but it is a narrow street-facing view (parked cars, a railing, a park across the street) with no lawn, planting bed, shrub, or hedge visible — it cannot be used to scope backyard cleanup or hedge trimming. To scope this job, new photos actually showing the backyard (and any hedges/shrubs in it) are needed.
